review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This position requires a highly skilled professional with expertise in infrastructure architecture, cloud systems, MSP tools, and automation. Job Qualifications Education and Experience  ·      Relevant Microsoft certifications  ·      Networking certifications advantageous  ·      3+ years of experience in a similar role within an MSP environment  Technical Skills  ·      Expertise in Windows Server, Azure infrastructure, and cloud technologies. ·      Proficiency with RMM tools (ConnectWise Automate) and PSA platforms (ConnectWise Manage). Job Requirements A home office set up that meets the following: Computer: A working computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM and one of the following: Windows 11 with an Intel i5 or i7 (8th generation or newer), or AMD Ryzen 5 or 7 (2000 series or newer), or macOS 12 or newer.
